findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_recent_searches · Private data: lookup_carrier, check_freight_bill, list_rfps, get_rfp · Public sink: check_freight_bill, draft_pushback_email, create_rfp · Destructive: estimate_network_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_recent_searches · Private data: lookup_carrier, check_freight_bill, list_rfps, get_rfp · Public sink: check_freight_bill, draft_pushback_email, create_rfp · Destructive: estimate_network_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "estimate_truckload_rate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
